title: Plausible positive proxy routes failed under hard endpoints
summary: Four promoted medical records now support a provisional cross-case pattern: a treatment or prevention claim traveled through a plausible positive evidentiary route—surrogate endpoint, intermediate biomarker, observational association, secondary finding, or mechanistic story—but a randomized hard-endpoint test showed no benefit or net harm. The pattern is intentionally framed as a record-design requirement, not a theory that proxies are useless. It says the archive must store prior route, endpoint tested, harm portfolio, and scope cautions separately.

status_history.note: Promoted as candidate after WHI, CAST, SELECT, and CARET records were admitted.

claims.claim: WHI, CAST, SELECT, and CARET each contain a source-backed pathway in which a plausible positive evidentiary route did not survive a hard-endpoint randomized test as a net-benefit claim.
what_would_change_status: A second review finds one of the four cases is a poor fit.
Negative controls show the pattern is too broad without subfamilies.
Better taxonomy splits surrogate-endpoint failures from observational-confounding and supplement-dose reversals.

evidence_refs.support_type: observational/intermediate cardioprotection route reversed or narrowed by global hard clinical outcomes
surrogate arrhythmia suppression did not predict survival benefit and coincided with excess mortality
supplement-prevention plausibility yielded no prevention and vitamin E harm signal
antioxidant/prevention plausibility yielded no benefit and harm in high-risk lung-cancer population

claims.claim: The useful archival rule emerging from the pattern is to encode prior evidentiary route, hard endpoint, harm portfolio, and scope cautions as separate fields rather than using a binary “worked/failed” verdict.
what_would_change_status: Record schema tests show these fields are insufficient or redundant.
Later medical records require additional fields such as competing-risk index or practice-lag endpoints.

evidence_profile.source_basis: four promoted medical negative-result/reversal records with trial/report sources
evidence_profile.review_state: pattern candidate only; not synthesized as stable theory
limitations: Medical prevention/treatment cases only; not yet cross-domain.
No negative controls where proxy/observational routes correctly predicted hard endpoints.
Needs subtyping: surrogate endpoint vs observational confounding vs nutrient-dose reversal vs global-index risk portfolio.
evidence_profile.red_team_state: rev0016 scaffold added; controls not yet promoted

type_payload.short_definition: A claim is supported by a narrower or more indirect evidentiary route, but when tested against patient-relevant randomized endpoints, the full benefit/harm portfolio is null or harmful.

case_evidence.mechanism: observational/intermediate cardioprotection route did not yield a viable chronic-disease prevention risk-benefit profile
arrhythmia suppression surrogate failed as survival proxy in target drug/population context
selenium/vitamin E prevention premise failed; vitamin E increased prostate cancer risk
beta-carotene/retinol prevention premise failed; lung-cancer incidence and mortality increased

not_this: Not a claim that observational studies, mechanisms, biomarkers, or surrogates are worthless.
Not a claim that all hormone therapy, antiarrhythmic therapy, or dietary nutrients are harmful.
Not a frequency estimate for medicine as a whole.
type_payload.record_design_rule: Every medical negative-result record should include prior_evidentiary_route, hard_endpoint_result, positive_findings_preserved, harms_preserved, and scope_cautions where applicable.
needed_before_synthesis: Add negative controls where proxy routes predicted hard benefit.
Split medical subpatterns after at least twelve cases.

positive_controls_needed: Add additional medical cases where a plausible proxy or observational route failed under hard randomized patient-relevant endpoints.
negative_controls_needed: Add cases where surrogate or observational evidence correctly predicted hard-endpoint net benefit under later trials.
counterexamples_to_seek: A trial where apparent hard-endpoint failure was mainly caused by protocol/population mismatch rather than proxy invalidity.
rollback_triggers: A second-review extraction demotes or materially weakens one of the support records.
A negative-control record shows the pattern label fits too many unrelated cases.
A counterexample shows the claimed recurrence is better explained by a narrower or different mechanism.
The pattern is upgraded only after controls and not by record count alone.
red_team_controls.split_or_merge_watch: High: surrogate failure, observational confounding, supplement dose/context reversal, and global-index risk portfolios are not the same mechanism.

maturity_gate.minimum_before_mature: At least one positive control, at least one negative control, an explicit counterexample search, and a rollback/split decision recorded in the claim-status ledger.

handling_notes: Pattern language must not erase patients, participant risk, or clinicians’ pre-trial uncertainty.
Keep scope-specific: intervention, dose, route, population, endpoint, and era.

unknowns: How to connect to regulatory surrogate endpoint policy
next_actions: Add bone marrow transplant for breast cancer and antiarrhythmic guideline records.
Add at least one negative-control or counterexample record before upgrading this pattern beyond candidate level.
